ERR_DISPLAY_BAD_WINDOW.message: Window ({x1}, {y1}) to ({x2}, {y2}) does not fit {id}, the pixels sent or the largest flush
ERR_DISPLAY_BAD_WINDOW.hint: Draw inside the panel's size, in pieces no larger than its largest flush (its geometry).

ERR_DISPLAY_FLUSH_BUSY.message: {id} is still drawing the previous window

ERR_DISPLAY_TRANSFER.hint: Check the display's wiring and its SPI clock.

ERR_DISPLAY_FLUSH_TIMEOUT.hint: The display was reset. Check its wiring, its SPI clock and the bus it shares.

ERR_DISPLAY_LOST.message: {id} does not answer or lost its power (health {health}, power mode {power_mode})
ERR_DISPLAY_LOST.hint: Check the display's cable and its supply. It is set up again and redrawn once it answers.
